title: བསྟན་འགྱུར། སྡེ་དགེ། ཚད་མ། ཕེ (Derge Tengyur, vol. 183)
shelf_note: Derge Tengyur volume 183 (Phe) belongs to the Pramāṇa (Tshad ma) section of the canonical Tibetan Tengyur.

tr_errors_A.problem: Omitted the lemma citation marker 'As for the words "that is..."' (de ni zhes bya ba) introducing the root text phrase

tr_errors_B.english: in order to show that valid cognition cannot be conceived apart from inference
tr_errors_B.problem: Misinterprets the ablative 'las' (from / through inference) as an exceptive ('apart from inference'), reversing the epistemological claim that validity cannot be established by means of inference

tr_errors_B.english: Regarding the statement "the knowledge of that...":
tr_errors_B.problem: Misconstrues the commentary citation formula 'de las' (from that [root verse], regarding the word 'of cognition') as 'knowledge of that'

pages.prefer_reason: Translation A correctly renders the core epistemological argument that validity cannot be conceptualized from inference and accurately parses the commentary's lemma citations.

book_verdict: A clear, well-scanned woodblock folio from the Pramāṇa section of the Derge Tengyur with flawless OCR transcription; Translation A provides a significantly more faithful and philosophically coherent translation than Translation B.
